#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys, json, re
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext, ROUND_HALF_UP

# Set high precision for Decimal operations
getcontext().prec = 200

# Unit definitions: mapping from unit to (factor relative to base unit, dimension)
UNITS = {
    # Length (base: mm)
    "mm": (Decimal('1'), "length"),
    "cm": (Decimal('10'), "length"),
    "m": (Decimal('1000'), "length"),
    "km": (Decimal('1000000'), "length"),
    "in": (Decimal('25.4'), "length"),
    "ft": (Decimal('304.8'), "length"),
    "yd": (Decimal('914.4'), "length"),
    "mi": (Decimal('1609344'), "length"),
    # Mass (base: mg)
    "mg": (Decimal('1'), "mass"),
    "g": (Decimal('1000'), "mass"),
    "kg": (Decimal('1000000'), "mass"),
    "t": (Decimal('1000000000'), "mass"),
    "lb": (Decimal('453592.37'), "mass"),
    "oz": (Decimal('28349.523125'), "mass"),
    "st": (Decimal('6350303.18'), "mass"),
    # Volume (base: ml)
    "ml": (Decimal('1'), "volume"),
    "l": (Decimal('1000'), "volume"),
    "m3": (Decimal('1000000'), "volume"),
    "gal": (Decimal('3785.411784'), "volume"),
    "qt": (Decimal('946.352946'), "volume"),
    "pt": (Decimal('473.176473'), "volume"),
    "floz": (Decimal('29.5735295625'), "volume"),
}

# Regex for valid numeric string (no sign, no exponent)
VALUE_RE = re.compile(r'^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read()
    data = data.strip()
    if not data:
        sys.exit(2)
    try:
        request = json.loads(data)
    except Exception:
        sys.exit(2)
    if not isinstance(request, dict):
        sys.exit(2)
    required_keys = {"value", "from", "to", "places"}
    if set(request.keys()) != required_keys:
        sys.exit(2)
    value_str = request["value"]
    unit_from = request["from"]
    unit_to = request["to"]
    places = request["places"]
    if not isinstance(value_str, str) or not VALUE_RE.fullmatch(value_str):
        sys.exit(2)
    if not isinstance(unit_from, str) or not isinstance(unit_to, str):
        sys.exit(2)
    if not isinstance(places, int) or not (0 <= places <= 12):
        sys.exit(2)
    if unit_from not in UNITS or unit_to not in UNITS:
        sys.exit(2)
    dim_from = UNITS[unit_from][1]
    dim_to = UNITS[unit_to][1]
    if dim_from != dim_to:
        sys.exit(2)
    try:
        value_dec = Decimal(value_str)
    except Exception:
        sys.exit(2)
    factor_from = UNITS[unit_from][0]
    factor_to = UNITS[unit_to][0]
    ratio = factor_from / factor_to
    product = value_dec * ratio
    # Rounding to requested places
    quant = Decimal(f'1e-{places}')
    result = product.quantize(quant, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    result_str = format(result, 'f')
    output = {
        "value": result_str,
        "unit": unit_to,
        "dimension": dim_from
    }
    json.dump(output, sys.stdout)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    sys.exit(0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
